description: Fußgängerzonen Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. Overview of publicly prescribed pedestrian zones in Vienna. In pedestrian areas, charging activities and cycling can be allowed. Step speed applies. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian zones Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include verkehrsberuhigte Bereiche, ViennaGIS, Verkehrsberuhigungsmaßnahmen, Fußgängerzonen, Fußgängerzone, Verkehrsplanung. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GML, CSV, SVG, PNG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
